vehicles.title: 2026 Toyota Camry
vehicles.scope: 2026 U.S. Camry sedan. All Camry trims use Toyota's fifth-generation hybrid system.

powertrains.output: 225 net combined hp FWD; 232 net combined hp AWD
powertrains.availability: FWD and Electronic On-Demand AWD on every grade

powertrainNotes: All Camrys are hybrid-only for 2026 and include Normal, Eco, and Sport drive modes.
The SE, Nightshade, and XSE have sport-tuned suspension; XSE adds the strongest sport-focused chassis/exterior equipment.
AWD changes both output and the EPA rating; compare the dedicated AWD table before choosing an in-stock vehicle.
standardEquipment: 2.5L four-cylinder fifth-generation Toyota Hybrid System: 225 net combined hp with FWD or 232 net combined hp with AWD.
Electronic On-Demand AWD is available on every trim; all have Normal, Eco, and Sport drive modes.
Toyota Safety Sense 3.0, Blind Spot Monitor, Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, Safe Exit Alert, LED headlights/DRLs, and a backup camera.
Push-button start, dual-zone automatic climate control with rear vents, Qi wireless charging, and five USB ports.
Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, dual Bluetooth phone connectivity, and six speakers.

rows.feature: Black exterior accents and black rear spoiler
Heated front seats / heated steering wheel
Blind Spot Monitor / Rear Cross-Traffic Alert
Front/rear parking sonar with automatic braking

highlights.text: Best economy and lowest entry price; the only 51-combined-MPG Camry in FWD form.
The practical sport trim with 18-inch black wheels, sport seating, and sport-tuned suspension.
Essentially a black-accented sport model, with exclusive 19-inch satin-black wheels, black grille/badging, and black spoiler.
Premium and quieter ride focus, with 12.3-inch displays, heated leather/microfiber seating, and upscale options.
Combines the higher-end technology with sport suspension, aggressive exterior styling, and 19-inch wheels.

notes: Premium Plus Package (XLE / XSE only): adds Traffic Jam Assist, Front Cross-Traffic Alert, Lane Change Assist, Panoramic View Monitor, Front and Rear Parking Assist with Automatic Braking, driver-seat/side-mirror memory, and automatic windshield wipers. Digital Key requires the applicable package and an active Remote Connect trial or subscription.

vehicles.title: 2026 Toyota Corolla
vehicles.scope: Corolla sedan for the U.S. market, model year 2026. Shopper-friendly comparison of standard equipment and major trim differences.

trims.name: LE
trims.blurb: Lowest-priced gas Corolla with the essential modern safety and phone features

trims.name: Hybrid LE
trims.blurb: Highest efficiency at the entry price point
trims.awdNote: AWD available — 51 / 44 MPG (city/hwy), price not separately stated

trims.name: Hybrid SE
trims.awdNote: AWD available — 47 / 41 MPG (city/hwy), price not separately stated

powertrains.trims: Hybrid LE, Hybrid SE, Hybrid XLE
powertrains.availability: FWD standard; Electronic On-Demand AWD available on Hybrid LE and Hybrid SE only

powertrainNotes: The Hybrid XLE is FWD only. Hybrid LE/SE AWD are distinct configurations, with their own lower EPA ratings.
Gas LE uses Normal and Eco drive modes. The SE, Hybrid SE, and XSE use Normal, Sport, and Eco; Hybrid LE and Hybrid XLE use Normal and Eco.
standardEquipment: Toyota Safety Sense 3.0, including Pre-Collision System with Pedestrian Detection, Full-Speed Range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control, Lane Departure Alert with Steering Assist, Lane Tracing Assist, Road Sign Assist, Automatic High Beams, and Proactive Driving Assist.
Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert and ten airbags.
An 8-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen (the XSE upgrades to 10.5 inches), six speakers, wireless Apple CarPlay and wireless Android Auto, SiriusXM trial, and front and rear USB-C ports.
FWD, electric power steering, four-wheel disc brakes, and a 5-passenger sedan body.
Toyota connected-services capability: Remote Connect, Safety Connect, Drive Connect, Service Connect, and Wi-Fi Connect. Trials/subscriptions and cellular coverage apply.

rows.feature: JBL premium audio (9 speakers, subwoofer, amplifier)
Blind Spot Monitor / Rear Cross-Traffic Alert
Front/rear parking sonar or parking assist

progression: LE to Hybrid LE: swaps the 2.0L gas drivetrain for the 1.8L hybrid system, adds the option of AWD, and improves fuel economy substantially.
LE / Hybrid LE to SE / Hybrid SE: moves toward a sport-focused setup: Sport mode, sport seats, 18-inch wheels, and multi-link rear suspension.
SE to XSE: retains the gas sport setup and adds the 12.3-inch gauge cluster, 10.5-inch screen, Smart Key, heated SofTex sport seats, standard moonroof, and available JBL audio.
Hybrid SE to Hybrid XLE: trades the sport emphasis for premium/comfort equipment: 12.3-inch gauge cluster, heated SofTex seats, standard moonroof, and available JBL audio. Hybrid XLE is FWD only.
notes: An A in the table does not mean it will be on every dealer vehicle; verify the window sticker or build sheet.
Toyota lists the LE Premium Package and SE Premium Package. These can change individual vehicle equipment such as Smart Key, moonroof, and larger multimedia displays.
Fuel-economy figures are EPA estimates; AWD hybrid figures are lower than their FWD counterparts.
MSRP excludes delivery, processing/handling, taxes, title/license, dealer-installed accessories, and dealer markup.

vehicles.title: 2026 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid
vehicles.scope: 2026 RAV4 Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV), not the separately sold RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid.

trims.name: LE
trims.awdNote: Electronic On-Demand AWD optional — EPA 45/39/42 MPG

trims.name: SE
trims.awdNote: Electronic On-Demand AWD optional — EPA 45/39/42 MPG

trims.name: XLE Premium
trims.awdNote: Electronic On-Demand AWD optional — EPA 45/38/41 MPG

powertrains.output: 226 net combined hp FWD; 236 net combined hp AWD
powertrains.availability: FWD on LE, SE, XLE Premium; AWD optional on those grades and standard on Woodland, XSE, Limited

powertrainNotes: All hybrid grades have Eco, Sport, Custom, and EV modes. EV mode is short-distance, low-speed operation when conditions permit.
Woodland has 8.5 inches of ground clearance; LE, SE, XLE Premium, and XSE have 8.1 inches. Woodland also includes all-terrain tires and a tow hitch.
AWD hybrid grades have a dedicated rear electric motor. XLE Premium, Woodland, SE AWD, and XSE/Limited AWD have up to 3,500-lb towing capability as specified by Toyota.

AWD availability: LE, SE, and XLE Premium can also be configured with Electronic On-Demand AWD. Woodland, XSE, and Limited Hybrid are AWD only. Toyota lists 45/39/42 MPG for LE/SE AWD and 45/38/41 MPG for XLE Premium AWD.
standardEquipment: Fifth-generation 2.5L four-cylinder Toyota Hybrid System: 226 net combined hp FWD or 236 hp AWD.
12.3-inch configurable digital gauge cluster; 10.5-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia system; wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto; five USB-C ports.
Toyota Safety Sense 4.0, Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, and backup camera with dynamic guidelines.
Push-button start, rear-seat fold-flat function, and a rear cargo tonneau cover.

rows.feature: Front and Rear Parking Assist with Automatic Braking
3D Panoramic View Monitor / advanced driver assists
Blind Spot Monitor / Rear Cross-Traffic Alert

highlights.text: Lowest-cost Hybrid RAV4; fabric seats and the complete safety/technology baseline.
Sport design with 18-inch black wheels, sport bumper/overfender styling, and blue interior accenting.
Core upgrade for comfort — heated SofTex seats, 8-way power driver seat, power liftgate, 18-inch alloys, and parking assist with automatic braking.

Standard AWD, all-terrain tires, 8.5-inch ground clearance, raised Woodland roof rails/crossbars, tow-hitch receiver, integrated Rigid Industries LED fog lamps, Woodland mats, and a cargo-area 120V/1,500W outlet.
Standard AWD sport premium grade — 20-inch black wheels, sport seating in SofTex/synthetic suede, heated/ventilated front seats, 12.9-inch screen, moonroof, and hands-free liftgate.

Top comfort/tech hybrid — panoramic glass roof, 9-speaker JBL audio, dual wireless chargers, rain-sensing wipers, 3D Panoramic View Monitor, Advanced Park, Front Cross-Traffic Alert, Lane Change Assist, and Traffic Jam Assist (subscription conditions apply).

notes: Woodland, SE, and XSE also exist in the RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid lineup, but those are different vehicles: PHEVs are AWD-only and have different pricing, output, range, and equipment. Do not compare their window stickers directly against the hybrid prices in this file.

vehicles.title: 2027 Toyota Prius
vehicles.scope: 2027 U.S. Prius hybrid (not Prius Plug-in Hybrid).

powertrains.output: 194 net combined hp FWD; 196 net combined hp AWD
powertrains.availability: FWD and Electronic On-Demand AWD on every grade

powertrainNotes: Toyota quotes 0-60 mph in 7.2 seconds for FWD and 7.0 seconds for AWD.
Every grade offers EV, Power, Eco, and Normal drive modes. EV mode is for short, low-speed operation when conditions allow.
AWD costs $1,400 versus the corresponding FWD grade and reduces the EPA rating; it is not a separate trim equipment package.
standardEquipment: Fifth-generation Toyota Hybrid System with a 2.0L four-cylinder engine: 194 net combined hp FWD, or 196 net combined hp AWD.
EV, Power, Eco, and Normal drive modes; 60/40 split folding rear seats; and a rear liftback cargo opening.
Toyota Safety Sense 3.0, Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, and a 7-inch top-mount digital gauge display.
Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, an 8-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia display, and Toyota connected-services capability.

rows.feature: Black SofTex seats with gray stitching
Blind Spot Monitor / Rear Cross-Traffic Alert
Front/rear parking sonar or parking assist
Proximity Sensing Keyless Entry / push-button start

highlights.text: Lowest price and best efficiency; its FWD 59/50 MPG rating is the range-focused choice.
Adds the key daily-comfort upgrades: 19-inch wheels, heated power SofTex seats, Qi charging, and rain-sensing wipers.
The XLE equipment direction with black 19-inch wheels, dark exterior details, black/gray SofTex seating, and carbon-fiber-look trim.
Adds the premium technology and convenience equipment: 12.3-inch touchscreen, JBL audio, fixed glass roof, power liftback, driver memory, and ventilated front seats.

notes: AWD is available on every grade; it adds traction and 2 hp, but reduces fuel economy and adds $1,400 versus the equivalent FWD grade.
